decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the sport associated with 'Richard Leach' (or 'Rick Leach'), likely due to distinct individuals sharing the name or data errors in the source texts. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states he was an All-American in 'singles and doubles' (implying tennis) and mentions his brother is married to 'tennis player' Lindsay Davenport. Document 2 (D2S1) lists his occupation as 'basketball player'. Document 3 (D3S2) claims he was an All-American in 'golf' and his brother married a 'golf player' (contradicting D1). Document 4 (D4S1) describes 'Richard Max "Rick" Leach' as a 'college football player' and 'professional baseball player'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all sources as fallible without inventing authority to resolve contradictions, all five distinct sports mentioned in the source segments are included as valid answers corresponding to the specific text claims found.
